verdict.rationale: AgentMail is email infrastructure that gives agents their own inboxes. It does not document an assistant of its own that answers grounded questions across a user's inbox and calendar. The closest evidence is building blocks: full-text thread search, organization-wide thread retrieval, a hosted MCP server exposing inbox and calendar tools to external clients, and a LangChain recipe for indexing messages into a vector store. These are primitives a developer or third-party assistant could use to construct this capability, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask an assistant questions across my whole inbox and calendar — who said what, what's outstanding — and get grounded answers
